Summer 2027

Summer basketball camp in Copenhagen

Dates for summer 2027 are coming. Join the list and you hear first.

Join the summer 2027 list

Every August we run a week of basketball camp in Copenhagen. In 2026 that was week 32 at Nørre Fælled Skole, with two tracks in the same hall: ages 5 to 12, and ages 13 to 17. Three courts and eight hoops, so everyone gets reps.

Photos from a Talata camp.

What a camp day looked like in 2026

Ages 13 to 17

  • Morning session: fundamentals and position work
  • Skill stations: shooting machine, dribbling, footwork
  • Lunch, included every day
  • Film and basketball IQ
  • 5 on 5 games and competitions

Ages 5 to 12

  • Morning session: fundamentals through games
  • Skill challenges: dribbling, passing, shooting
  • A snack every day
  • Small games, 3 on 3 and 5 on 5
  • A fun competition to finish

The week ended on Friday with an All-Star Game for both tracks. Parents, siblings and Mini players came to watch, and we closed with awards and snacks.

Who runs it

Coach Deng and the same coaches who run Talata sessions all season. Meet the coaches.

Before summer

We run camps in the October and December school holidays too, at Hafnia-Hallen. See the next camps.
